info.title: Blexchat API
info.description: REST API for Blexchat — social commerce DM and comment automation platform supporting Instagram, WhatsApp, TikTok, and Messenger.

get.description: For the app greeting ("Welcome back, Nour") and to check a stored token is still valid: 401 means sign in again.

post.description: Revokes the token this request was made with; other devices stay signed in.

get.summary: Start signing up or in with Google
get.description:
Send the visitor to `url`. Google returns them, with `code` and `state` in the query, to the redirect URI this server is set to:

- **Frontend** (default, `FRONTEND_URL/verify/confirm`): that page posts both to **POST /api/v1/auth/google** within 15 minutes. If Google returns `error` instead, show "Google sign-in didn’t finish".
- **This API** (`GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI=…/api/v1/auth/google/callback`, for testing without the frontend): Google lands on **GET /api/v1/auth/google/callback**, which signs in and shows the token as JSON.

post.summary: Finish signing up or in with Google
post.description: Creates the account on first use with the Google email and name. Same answer as the email link: `is_new_user` decides onboarding or the app.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the texts in the response, and of the email where one is sent. Takes precedence over Accept-Language. Defaults to en.

code.description: The `code` query value Google sent back

state.description: The `state` query value Google sent back

422.description: Missing fields, a stale `state` (validation error), or `google_failed`: Google refused the code or the email is not verified

get.summary: Google’s return to this API (testing without the frontend)
get.description: Used only when GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI points here. Google opens this URL in the browser with `code` and `state`; the answer is the same as POST /api/v1/auth/google, shown as JSON. Copy `access_token` into Authorize to try the signed-in endpoints.

post.summary: Email a sign-in link (sign up and sign in)
post.description:
Sign-up and sign-in are passwordless: this emails a link to the address, whether or not it has an account yet.
The link opens `FRONTEND_URL/verify/confirm?token=…` (with `&mode=signin` when signing in); that page posts the token to **POST /api/v1/auth/email-link/verify**.

- A link works **once, for 15 minutes**.
- Another link to the same address can be sent after **59 seconds** (`resend_after`); earlier, the answer is 429 `resend_too_soon` with `retry_after`.
- After 5 links in 15 minutes the answer is 429 `too_many_attempts` ("Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.").
- `mode` only changes the email's wording: `signup` (default) "Confirm your email", `signin` "Your sign-in link".

**Development servers only:** with `AUTH_EXPOSE_LOGIN_LINKS=true` the response also carries `dev_link` and `dev_token`, so the flow can be tested without an inbox. Never present in production.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the texts in the response, and of the email where one is sent. Takes precedence over Accept-Language. Defaults to en.

resend_after.description: Seconds before another link can be sent

dev_link.description: Development servers only: the emailed link

dev_token.description: Development servers only: the token to post to /email-link/verify

post.summary: Sign in with the token from the emailed link
post.description:
Called by the frontend's verify page ("One more step") with the `token` from its URL.
Creates the account on first use, and returns the bearer token for every later request (`Authorization: Bearer …`).

- `is_new_user: true` → a new account: go to onboarding ("Account created").
- `is_new_user: false` → a returning user: go to the app ("Welcome back").
- 410 `link_expired` → the link was used already, is past its 15 minutes, or is unknown. `data.email` (when known) is the address to offer "Send a new link" to.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the texts in the response, and of the email where one is sent. Takes precedence over Accept-Language. Defaults to en.

token.description: The `token` query value of the emailed link

get.summary: Get the complete public marketing homepage
get.description:
Every homepage section in display order and the live-demo reply rules. No authentication.

**Language**
- Send `?lang=ar` for Arabic or `?lang=en` for English.
- Without `lang`, the `Accept-Language` header is used (`ar`, `ar-SA`, `en-US`…).
- A missing or unsupported language returns English.
- The response states the language it was served in: `meta.locale` and the `Content-Language` header.
- Any text not yet translated is served in English, field by field, and `meta.fallback` is then `true`.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the texts in the response, and of the email where one is sent. Takes precedence over Accept-Language. Defaults to en.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Used only when `lang` is absent; the first two letters are read (ar-SA → ar).

locale.description: Language the content was served in

fallback.description: True when at least one text is not translated yet and is served in English

404.description: Homepage content has not been seeded

get.summary: Start connecting an Instagram professional account
get.description: Send the owner to `url`. Instagram returns them to INSTAGRAM_REDIRECT_URI with `code` and `state`; post both to POST /api/v1/channels/instagram within 15 minutes.

post.summary: Finish connecting an Instagram professional account
post.description: Exchanges the code for a long-lived token, saves the account and subscribes it to comments and messages. Reconnecting an account refreshes its token.

get.summary: Where the owner is in onboarding
get.description: Call it after sign-in when `is_new_user` is true, or on a reload mid-onboarding, to resume at `next_step`. A step skipped on the frontend stays not done here.

get.description: Every plan on sale, in the admin order. Public: the pricing page can use it too.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the texts in the response. Takes precedence over Accept-Language. Defaults to en.

post.description:
- **Free** ("Continue with Free"): active at once.
- **A plan with `trial_days`** ("Start free trial" in the checkout): a trial starts and no card is taken. It does not convert: when it ends the account is on Free again. One trial per account.
- **Any other paid plan** answers 402 `payment_required`: card payments are not built yet.

Choosing again replaces the current plan.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the texts and error messages in the response. Takes precedence over Accept-Language. Defaults to en.

402.description: `payment_required`: a paid plan without a trial

409.description: `trial_used`: this account already had its free trial
